caption: Each 20 s block, the rider at 5 m/s moves 5 × 20 = 100 m, exactly the minimum distance, so the time filter decides and fixes 1, 2 and 3 can arrive at the ticks. That gives at most 60 ÷ 20 = 3 updates in a minute.

spec.aria: A 60-second timeline: the rider moving at 5 metres per second covers 100 metres in each 20-second block, so the 100-metre distance filter is met and at most three fixes are delivered in a minute, marked 1, 2 and 3.
